title: rosa canina f. sphaerica
intro: Rosa canina f. sphaerica, commonly known as Dwarf Wild Rose or Shiny-leaved Dog Rose, is a variant of the Rosa canina species, characterized by its smaller leaves and compact growth habit. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which can help to soothe and protect the skin. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina f. sphaerica include wound healing, anti-aging, and protection against oxidative stress, making it a valuable ingredient in skincare and cosmetic products. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and health benefits.
